_comment: Held-out alerts for measuring RETRIEVAL, not prose. No model is called, so
running this costs nothing and can be repeated freely.
Each alert is a NEW occurrence written to resemble a known root-cause
family without copying any stored incident's wording: timeouts differ,
some carry extra clauses real tools emit, and several deliberately have no
exact signature match so only tags can find them.
Honest limitation: these were hand-written from the same six families the
data describes, so this measures whether retrieval ranks the right family,
not whether it generalises to phrasing nobody anticipated. Alerts drawn
from real production logs would be a stronger test.

alerts.name: pool exhaustion, unseen service, different timeout
alerts.error: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 45000ms.
alerts.note: normalisation must reduce 45000ms to Nms for the signature to match

alerts.name: pool failure after failover, no signature overlap with the common one
alerts.error: Connection marked as broken because of SQLSTATE(08006)

alerts.name: OOM phrased as a kernel message - tags only
alerts.error: worker killed: memory cgroup limit of 2147483648 bytes exceeded
alerts.note: no stored signature resembles this; only tags can reach the family

alerts.name: redis restart, cold cache
alerts.error: LOADING Redis is loading the dataset in memory

alerts.name: redis command timeout, seconds not millis
alerts.error: RedisCommandTimeoutException: Command timed out after 5 s

alerts.name: expired cert with the trailing clause Go actually prints
alerts.error: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid: current time 2026-10-11T02:00:00Z is after 2026-10-01T23:59:59Z
alerts.note: the extra clause defeats exact signature matching - the known limitation

alerts.name: untrusted CA on an outbound call
alerts.error: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority

alerts.name: consumer group rebalancing continuously
alerts.error: CommitFailedException: Commit cannot be completed since the group has already rebalanced

alerts.name: lag alert with a concrete figure
alerts.error: Consumer group notification-worker lag exceeded 1500000 messages
alerts.note: 1500000 is normalised to N; the stored signature has no number at all

alerts.name: deploy pointed at a missing index

negatives.name: genuinely novel failure, no tags
negatives.error: kernel panic - not syncing: attempted to kill init
negatives.note: nothing should come back; a guess here would be worse than silence

negatives.name: unseen failure with one generic tag
negatives.error: panic: integer divide by zero in settlement batch
negatives.note: one generic tag must not qualify anything - the MIN_SHARED_TAGS rule
